questions.question: Should transactions that were already saved a cent short before this fix ships be corrected/migrated to their accurate amounts, or should the fix only apply going forward to new entries and imports (leaving existing balances as-is)?
questions.rationale: This determines whether the fix needs a data migration/backfill in addition to a code change, and directly affects whether existing users' historical balances remain permanently off by a cent or get retroactively corrected — a major difference in scope, risk, and user-facing impact.

questions.question: For amounts that fall exactly (or effectively, due to floating-point representation) halfway between two cents, which rounding rule should be used — round half up, round half down, or round half to even (banker's rounding)?
questions.rationale: The choice of halfway-rounding rule changes the exact saved amount for a class of real transaction values, so it needs to be a deliberate business decision rather than an implementation detail, to ensure consistent and expected behavior for users and to correctly scope the regression tests.
